title: Asean Summit: Cops told to respect human rights amid tighter security
summary: MANILA, Philippines—The National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) has directed its personnel to uphold human rights and exercise professionalism as they enforce heightened security measures for…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) has directed its personnel to uphold human rights and exercise professionalism as they enforce heightened security measures for the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits. “Let us perform our duties with professionalism, vigilance, and respect for human rights,” said NCRPO Acting Regional Director Brig. Gen. Christopher Abrahano
